classes.example_reason: seat busy: seat is at its run cap
classes.meaning: A seat answered a capacity defer after admission.
classes.root_cause: Another job held what the call needed.

cause.root_cause: The seat or card the call needed was held by other work when it arrived: the seat was at its local run cap (`seat busy:`), a GPU lease of another class held the card (`gpu busy: held by ...`), or a media job waited for host RAM. It also holds the two text-lease holds filed elsewhere until 2026-11-12: the delegator's `local seat reserved (gpu lease ...)` (a text lease holds the only seat the call may use and no remote had room; filed `infrastructure`) and a node's `a text lease holds its card; it may take the call later` (filed `other`). The harness defers rather than overload the card.
cause.evidence: pipeline/agenttask.go (seat busy, defer class capacity), pipeline/pipeline_gpu.go (gpu busy), ledger RefileStamped and DeferCode (the lease holds); 628 rows in 30 days as stamped: video 247, research 205, audio 109 (the agent pool at its cap, a media lease on the cards, host RAM), and 93 more once the lease holds are read here (79 from infrastructure, 14 from other)
cause.action: none: working as designed. Fewer deferrals need more free card time (keep a card free for media while text leases run) or a higher run cap on a box with room.

classes.meaning: The model ran and gave no usable answer.

cause.root_cause: The answer was cut at its completion token cap, so there was nothing usable to return: the vision lane's `vision output truncated` (117 rows) and an agent answer cut at the completion budget so the re-pack was skipped (about 94 rows, `output_truncated`). The cap is a setting of the seat or the call.
cause.evidence: pipeline/pipeline_vision.go:315 and pipeline/agentlistcap.go:75; 221 rows in 30 days, 107 on one vision seat's questions
cause.action: raise the vision lane's output cap for that seat, or ask for shorter answers; not investigated: why those answers run past the cap.

classes.meaning: A result failed the contract's own checks.

cause.root_cause: not investigated: the rows say which check failed (`min_items` on plans, quotes or numbers; a regex) but not whether the seat's answer was wrong or the check too strict; the acceptance list is shape-only (delegate/lint.go warns of it)
cause.evidence: delegate/run.go (failed verification); 357 rows in 30 days, 345 of them from research subtasks
cause.action: not investigated: read the saved output of a sample of failed research subtasks against their acceptance lists

classes.example_reason: capacity wait: no node had room

cause.root_cause: No node had room for the subtask before the call's deadline: 248 of 267 waited until the call's own deadline (not agent_placement_wait_sec), 259 for one node's agent pool alias.
cause.evidence: delegate/run_wait.go:436 and :442; 267 rows in 30 days, 259 on one pool alias
cause.action: none: working as designed. Reducing it needs more worker slots on the pool's node, or fewer research subtasks per call.

cause.root_cause: A limit the call carried ended the run before the agent finished: the call's own deadline (`call deadline reached`, `wall timeout after ... the caller's deadline`), or the step budget (`step budget exhausted`). Most are the caller's deadline, not a node ceiling. The agent loop's `agent loop: canceled` was filed here until 2026-11-12 and is now `canceled`; the browse door's `browse: budget:` (max_actions spent) is read here.
cause.evidence: core/calldeadline.go, pipeline/liveness.go:411, pipeline/agenttask.go:1295; 250 rows in 30 days as stamped, 241 from research subtasks; 17 of them are loop cancellations that ledger RefileStamped now reads as canceled
cause.action: give long research subtasks a longer call deadline or fewer subtasks per call; a run that ends on the step budget needs a larger max_steps.

cause.root_cause: A seat or node was set up so that it cannot serve the call: a seat's tool-call parser does not match its chat template, so a tool call came back as text (2 rows), or a node's configured data folder does not exist on that machine, so it could not create its pipeline-jobs folder for a dispatch (30 rows, one node; filed `dispatch_refused` until 2026-11-12).
cause.evidence: pipeline/agenttask.go:1303 and fleetnode/tasks.go:1031 (read by ledger RefileStamped); 2 rows in 30 days as stamped, 32 once the folder fault is read here
cause.action: set that seat's --tool-call-parser to the one its chat template needs; fix or remove the node's missing data folder (its `home`).

cause.root_cause: A node host did not answer on the network: a dial that timed out (`the connected party did not properly respond`) or a poll that never got an answer. Why the host did not answer (asleep, off, network) is not recorded on the row.
cause.evidence: delegate/run_remote.go; 3 rows in 30 days, 2 on one node
cause.action: none from the harness: the node host or path is the fault; `local-offload doctor` shows which nodes answer now.

cause.root_cause: not investigated: the class is the residue no rule names, a mix of causes. Since 2026-11-12 a node's `a text lease holds its card; it may take the call later` is read as node_busy, and the browse door's `BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE`, `DECISION_UNAVAILABLE`, `HOST_NOT_ALLOWED` and `budget` errors by their own classes; what is left is mostly the browse door's `blocked` (the model reported it cannot proceed, 4 rows) and media and compose sentences no rule names
cause.evidence: reasoncode.go DeferCode (the residue); 55 rows in 30 days as stamped (audio 18, browse 15, video 7, compose 6), 30 once the rules above are read
cause.action: not investigated: list the distinct reasons of the rows left and add a rule per sentence that ties to one class

classes.example_reason: poll budget spent: the node still owned the job
classes.meaning: A node owned the job and it did not finish inside the poll budget.
classes.root_cause: A job larger than the budget.

cause.root_cause: not investigated: the class does not separate a job longer than the poll budget from a node that stopped making progress (failurekinds.go says so), and the 3 rows differ (a poll error, a stale last-progress, the node's own wall)
cause.evidence: delegate/run_remote.go (poll deadline after); 3 rows in 30 days
cause.action: not investigated: for each row, compare the node's own record of the job with the delegator's poll budget

classes.meaning: The run went silent while the prompt was being processed.

cause.root_cause: not investigated: the rows say no progress in prefill past an allowance computed from the prompt size and the seat's rate; a prompt larger than the allowance or a wedged engine both read so
cause.evidence: agent/liveness.go; 0 rows in 30 days, 246 in the whole ledger (written before the stamp)
cause.action: not investigated: compare the prompt size of those rows with the seat's measured prefill rate
